reuse.why: Adds a new getRangeAmount next to the existing getScheduledAmount (which already resolves number-or-range) and has the five server sites call the narrower helper instead of the existing one.

duplication.why: The midpoint arithmetic is removed from every site, but each site keeps its own number/range (and missing) dispatch around getRangeAmount, so that dispatch still exists in five copies parallel to getScheduledAmount.

placement.why: The rule lives in shared/schedules.ts, which is where the tree keeps schedule amount logic.

scope.why: Only the range rule, the sites that applied it, comments, tests and a release note are touched.

maintainability.why: The rule now has one definition that every path uses, though a maintainer still has two overlapping helpers and repeated per-site dispatch.

bypasses_abstraction.where: schedule-template.ts createScheduleList, forecast-schedules.ts normalizeSchedule, schedules/app.ts updateActions and postTransactionForSchedule, shared/schedules.ts computeSchedulePreviewTransactions dispatch number vs range themselves instead of calling the existing getScheduledAmount.

one_place.where: getRangeAmount in packages/loot-core/src/shared/schedules.ts, called by getScheduledAmount and by every server-side site that resolves a ranged amount.
